findings.reason: A published French HadeethEnc text is recoverable, but the historical French/Arabic presentation located omits the cowardice clause that is present in the current canonical Muslim 2722 wording. Exact full-matn equivalence is therefore not established for promotion.

The French hadith text displayed gives the concise invocation for guidance and rectitude, while the canonical structure explicitly includes the road/arrow illustration contained in the Arabic matn. The displayed French translation does not establish full coverage of that canonical matn.
